answer_1.quote: Fact-to-text (F2T) is a natural language generation (NLG) task where input is structured data ... and output is its natural language description.
answer_1.outputs: natural language sentences in the target low‑resource language generated from English fact triples

answer_2.quote: We use overall BLEU scores for evaluating the multi‑lingual models ... we also use METEOR and chrF++.

answer_4.quote: Finally, we obtain human annotations to evaluate the perceived quality of the generated text. Table 10 shows results for our best model across three metrics: fluency, coverage and hallucination ... evaluated on 100 samples for 7 languages on a 5‑point Likert scale per metric.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators rated each generated sentence on a 5‑point Likert scale for fluency, coverage (fact correctness) and hallucination (absence of extra information).
